description: 令和8年熊本地震(斜め写真)【国際航業株式会社】 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国際航業株式会社. 令和8年7月28日に発生した令和8年熊本地震に対して弊社では緊急で航空写真撮影を実施しました（撮影日：令和8年7月29日）。 今回の災害で被災された方々にお見舞い申し上げるとともに、弊社の所有する技術が、被災状況の把握ならびに今後の復旧に少しでもお役に立てれば幸いです。 ◆著作権 ・本航空写真の著作権は国際航業株式会社及び株式会社パスコに... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国際航業株式会社. Its tags are 令和8年熊本地震. It offers 48 resource(s) in jpeg, pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
